archetypes.name: Longsword
archetypes.identity: Straight double-edged European longsword, symmetrical crossguard, medium two-hand leather grip, diamond pommel. Preserve a pointed double-edged blade.

archetypes.name: Greatsword
archetypes.identity: Huge broad straight double-edged two-handed greatsword, very long two-hand grip, wide crossguard, hefty faceted pommel. Blade is broad and monumental, with pronounced shoulders. Never a slim one-handed sword.

archetypes.name: Katana
archetypes.identity: Recognizable Japanese-inspired katana: gently curved SINGLE-EDGED blade, clear cutting edge and spine, round or oval tsuba disk guard, long wrapped two-hand grip, small kashira end cap. All tiers remain katana. Never a medieval cruciform crossguard or a straight double-edged longsword.

archetypes.name: Rapier
archetypes.identity: Recognizable slim straight needle-point rapier with narrow blade, elaborate swept/basket metal hand guard, one-hand grip and small pommel. Keep the visible basket/swept guard across all paths. Light fencing weapon, never a broad cleaver.

archetypes.name: Scimitar
archetypes.identity: Strongly curved single-edged scimitar, visibly sweeping broad crescent blade which widens toward the outer curved tip, compact quillon crossguard, curved one-hand grip. No enclosed knuckle guard. Keep the deep sweeping curve across all paths.

archetypes.name: Sabre
archetypes.identity: Moderately curved single-edged cavalry sabre with a clearly visible D-shaped knuckle bow or half-basket hand guard, one-hand grip. Slender sweeping blade with a tapered pointed tip; distinct from a broad scimitar.

archetypes.name: Gladius
archetypes.identity: Short broad Roman-inspired gladius with broad waist-shaped double-edged blade, triangular spear point, very small rounded guard, compact segmented grip and spherical pommel. Short stocky proportions across every tier, never a long longsword.

archetypes.name: Falchion
archetypes.identity: Medieval single-edged falchion: substantial cleaver-like blade which widens toward a clipped pointed tip, pronounced broad cutting belly, short asymmetric crossguard, one-hand grip. Clear heavy chopping construction, not a symmetrical double-edged longsword.

archetypes.name: Flamberge
archetypes.identity: Distinct physical flamberge: straight overall axis but a continuous WAVY UNDULATING double-edged METAL blade silhouette from forte to tip, two-hand grip and wide crossguard. Wavy physical edges are preserved even on neutral and stone versions. Not literal flames unless on Fire path.

archetypes.name: Estoc
archetypes.identity: Rigid straight armor-piercing estoc with long narrow triangular or diamond-section spike blade, angular modest cruciform guard and long two-hand grip, faceted pommel. Straight thick thrusting spike, visibly distinct from a swept-guard rapier. No basket guard.

paths.name: Neutral
paths.visual_direction: Forged iron and steel, brown leather and restrained brass/gold accents. No magic element. Progress from plain worn iron to a grand structured masterwork with engraved steel and a magnificent guard.

paths.name: Nature
paths.visual_direction: Living wood ribs, green organic blade details, structural roots and attached leaves. Progress from a steel blade with a tiny root to a majestic green living weapon with branch guard. Preserve the sword archetype.

paths.name: Earth
paths.visual_direction: Solid cool gray/beige stone, slate and granite, opaque smoky-quartz inclusions and muted bronze supports. Progress from chipped stone to a broad stepped mountain-ridge construction. Absolutely NO orange glowing channels, lava, fire or vegetation.

paths.name: Fire
paths.visual_direction: Dark forged metal, red/orange internal ember seams and controlled flame-shaped construction. Progress from an ember edge to a magnificent physical flame-shaped metal weapon. Effects remain attached and tight to the blade.

paths.name: Water
paths.visual_direction: Translucent aqua/blue water-glass and silver flowing wave details. Progress from a small blue steel inset to an elaborate tidal crystalline weapon with pearl guard. No detached droplets or puddles.

paths.name: Rootstone
paths.visual_direction: At least two-thirds blade area is solid GRAY STONE held together by living BROWN ROOTS, a few small GREEN LEAVES on the guard. Progress from a stone shard bound by one root to a massive layered mineral blade with root buttresses and branching guard. Never become a green leaf blade.

paths.name: Magma
paths.visual_direction: Heavy solid BLACK BASALT/OBSIDIAN with contained ORANGE LAVA channels. Progress from a cracked volcanic blade to layered angular rock plates around a contained lava spine and furnace guard. Heavy mineral construction, clearly distinct from Fire metal.

paths.name: Bloomtide
paths.visual_direction: Translucent AQUA water-crystal blade and visible GREEN plant veins, stems and lotus-like petal guard. Progress from a water blade with vine grip to a magnificent water-crystal weapon supported by organic branches and a pearl lotus center.

paths.name: Ashthorn
paths.visual_direction: BLACK CHARRED WOOD grain, physical THORNS and glowing RED/ORANGE fiery heartwood. Progress from an ember thorn blade to a magnificent sculpted charred thornwood weapon with red-orange attached leaves and burning resin channels. Wood must be visibly distinct from Fire metal.

paths.name: Tidalstone
paths.visual_direction: At least two-thirds blade area is SOLID BLUE-GRAY SLATE, angular stepped mineral edges, narrow TURQUOISE water-glass inlays. Progress from chipped slate with aqua seam to a heavy tiered stone weapon with contained water core and architectural pearl guard. Never an all-blue wavy water blade.

paths.name: Frost
paths.visual_direction: Opaque white and pale icy-blue crystalline ice, frosted steel and silver snowflake-like geometric guard. Progress from frosted edges to layered pointed ice facets and a grand snow-crystal guard. No water waves or loose snow particles.

paths.name: Lightning
paths.visual_direction: Dark steel and bright electric YELLOW/WHITE crystalline channels with angular forked-conductor guard. Progress from a small yellow lightning inset to a structured storm-conductor weapon with zigzag edged geometry. No detached lightning outside the object.

paths.name: Shadow
paths.visual_direction: Deep black-violet steel, amethyst inlays, dark smoke-free void-glass details and hooked guard. Progress from a dark purple seam to a menacing physically solid obsidian-violet weapon. Crisp silhouette, no black clouds or haze.

paths.name: Stormglass
paths.visual_direction: Deep translucent CYAN/BLUE water-glass with contained bright YELLOW electrical conductor veins and a silver branching storm guard. Progress from a blue crystalline blade with yellow seam to a sculptural storm-glass weapon with angular electric structures. Both parents visible.

paths.name: Frostroot
paths.visual_direction: White ICE plates on woody ROOTS, small desaturated green needles and pale blue frozen sap. Progress from frosted twig-supported steel to a layered icy weapon held in a branching brown root lattice, frost-crystal guard. Both ice and living wood remain visible.

paths.name: Permafrost
paths.visual_direction: Heavy angular GRAY ROCK slabs with opaque WHITE/PALE-BLUE ICE wedged between layers, silver guard. Progress from frozen stone to a monumental stepped glacial stone weapon. Mostly physical rock, clearly different from all-ice Frost.

paths.name: Obsidian Night
paths.visual_direction: Heavy glossy BLACK OBSIDIAN mineral blade, opaque PURPLE AMETHYST seams and angular stone guard. Progress from a dark shard to a broad sculpted volcanic-glass weapon with stepped mineral buttresses. No orange fire, no smoke.

paths.name: Emberstorm
paths.visual_direction: Dark conductive forged metal with ORANGE ember channels and distinct bright YELLOW lightning crystal nodes. Progress from a hot electric edge to a sculptural flame-metal weapon with a branching thunder-conductor guard. Two distinguishable orange/yellow energies contained in the structure.

paths.name: Voidbloom
paths.visual_direction: BLACK/VIOLET woody thorn blade with deep PURPLE living petals, dark green attached leaves and amethyst seed core. Progress from a shadow-touched twig weapon to an elaborate dark botanical weapon with a blooming violet guard. Physical wood/plant construction, no fog.

paths.name: Eclipse
paths.visual_direction: BLACK/VIOLET metal/void-glass armor around a contained ORANGE/CRIMSON ember core, crescent/corona guard motifs. Progress from dark steel with red ember seam to an imposing eclipse-forged weapon with black blade shell and a controlled fiery core. Crisp dark outer construction and contained fire.
